ticker_shape.map_market: <map_series>-<key>-<n>-<TEAM>, two markets a map; n is the map number
ticker_shape.key: starts with the date and a four-digit clock time, for example 26NOV101300: the scheduled start, read as US Eastern time

best_of_three_rule: a match is in the sample only if its total-maps event has a market with floor_strike 2.5 and none with a higher strike, and map markets numbered 1 and 2 exist for the same key
sample: the 1,500 most recently closed best-of-three matches inside the window, across the four titles together, never extended
